questions.question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting clockwise around a circular table facing the centre in the same sequence at equal distances between them. If H is sitting in the North direction, then in which direction is D sitting?
questions.solution:
Eight friends** A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H** are sitting clockwise around a circular table facing the centre in the same sequence at equal distances between them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0461647215920ee8986f23cb5057ba3492a9d7ce8cf9076e9e6efb46c58f81b.png] 

If H is sitting in the North direction, D is sitting in the South direction.

Hence, '**South**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some crocodiles are animals.

No animal is a leopard.

**Conclusions:**

I. No leopard is an animal.

II. Some animals are crocodiles

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de035b5495ff5ba6575a73c0d76f98d22e5a5af4bb044d932911c67fde9d8394.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No leopard is an animal. → **Follow** (As, no animal is a leopard so no leopard is an animal is definite follow)

II. Some animals are crocodiles → **Follow** (As some crocodiles are animals so, some animals are crocodiles is definite follow)

Hence, **Both conclusions I and II follow**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Combine : Separate : : Insufficient : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Combine : Separate → Combine is antonym of Separate.

Similarly,

 
• Insufficient : ? → Insufficient is antonym of Abundant.

Hence, '**Abundant**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

7, 21, 63, ?, 567
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

7 × 3 = 21

21 × 3 = 63

63 × 3 = **189**

189 × 3 = 567 

Hence, '**189**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'NOSTRIL' is written as 'TSRONLI', and 'PLAY' is written as 'YPLA'. How will 'FLUIDITY' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• NOSTRIL

 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: T > S > R > O > N > L > I
 
• Therefore, code = TSRONLI
 
 
 
• PLAY
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: Y > P > L > A
 
• Therefore, code = YPLA
 
 
 
• FLUIDITY
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: Y > U > T > L > I = I > F > D
 
• Therefore, code = YUTLIIFD
 
 

Hence, '**YUTLIIFD**' is the correct answer.

Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are indicated by A, B, C, D, E and F. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'E'.

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Both the positions of the dice have a common face → C , F

Therefore, we eliminated C and F.

So, E will opposite of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09dfdcc7a091a988b2dc92adbbd7e97807c652b88a7da1f9a06c1404b7b14191.png] 

 
 

 Position 1 of Dice
 C

questions.question: Pointing towards the photograph of a boy, a woman named Leena said, "He is the son of my father's only son's wife." How is Leena related to that boy's father?
questions.solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/216f22577d64476456b4001c8c4662c4ad629617a78ea252dee3722f4063a9fc.png] 

 
• My father's only son's wife → Sister-in-law
 
• Son of my father's only son's wife → Nephew

So, the boy is the son of Leena's brother, which means Leena is the sister of the boy's Father in the photograph.

Hence, 'Sister' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Stomach : Digestive system : : Kidney : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Stomach : Digestive system → The main organs that make up the **digestive system** are the mouth, esophagus, **stomach**, small intestine, large intestine, rectum and anus.

Similarly,

 
• Kidney : ? → The main organs that make up the **excretory system** are **kidney**, ureter, urinary bladder and urethra. Kidneys filter the blood and urine is the filtrate obtained.

Hence, '**Excretory system**' is the correct answer.
